start.speaker: hamdi
start.line: Deck passage upriver for your whole party: twenty pounds. But I warn you, the Americans have booked half my deck.

choices.label: Book passage
choices.line: Twenty pounds. Keep us a corner of that deck.

choices.label: Ask about the river
choices.line: Is the river safe these days?

booked.speaker: hamdi
booked.line: Then you sail with us. Keep your guns cleaned and your Americans sober.

river.speaker: hamdi
river.line: Mostly. But riders have been seen on the banks, south of the bend. Strange ones. They don't rob boats. They watch them.

bye.speaker: hamdi
bye.line: The boat leaves with or without you.
